name: Gahz'ridian
summary: Marvon Rivetseeker, a scientist and treasure hunter at heart, wants thirty ornaments left behind by the trolls who once lived in Tanaris. Marvon gives you a detector of their own invention to help find them.

sections.title: Relics of the Hydra God
sections.body: Long ago trolls occupied this land, and they made great numbers of ornaments in the likeness of Gahz'rilla, a hydra they revered as a god. Marvon Rivetseeker calls the element these were carved from Gahz'ridian, after the hydra god. Marvon has found a few and would like more to study.

sections.title: The Detector
sections.body: Marvon has invented a detector that makes finding Gahz'ridian simple, and gives it to you. Wearing it starts the search. Ornaments can be found nearly anywhere in Tanaris, though they gather thickest near Broken Pillar, the Eastmoon Ruins and the Southmoon Ruins.

faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker is a scientist in Tanaris who is also a treasure hunter at heart. He studies the ornaments the old trolls made.
It is Marvon Rivetseeker's name for the element the trolls' hydra ornaments were carved from, taken from the hydra god.
Gahz'rilla is a hydra that the old trolls revered as a god. They made their ornaments in its likeness.
Nearly anywhere in Tanaris, though the heaviest concentrations are around Broken Pillar and the Eastmoon and Southmoon Ruins.

faq.q: How do you find the ornaments?
faq.answer: Marvon has invented a detector for the purpose. Wearing it starts the search.
